# tplinkeasysmart_vlan_mtu (Data Source)

MTU VLAN mode (VLAN > MTU VLAN). Read-only. When enabled, all ports are isolated from each other and only reach the uplink port.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_vlan_mtu" "this" {}

output "mtu_vlan" {
  value = data.tplinkeasysmart_vlan_mtu.this.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `switch` (String) Name of the switch (a key of the provider's `switches` map) this object lives on. Omit it to use the provider's own switch (`host`), or the only configured switch.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether MTU VLAN mode is active.
- `id` (String) Always `vlan_mtu`.
- `uplink_port` (Number) Uplink port (1 when the mode is disabled).
